name: Get Lead by ID
summary: Fetches a single lead's data using their Marketo ID. You can optionally restrict which fields come back.
whenToUse: When you know the lead's numeric Marketo ID (from a landing page URL, an email link, or another call) and want that person's current field values.

path.name: id
path.label: Lead ID
path.hint: The lead's numeric Marketo ID. If you only know their email, use 'Get Leads by Filter Type' instead.

query.name: lookupToken
query.label: Lookup token (instead of ID)
query.hint: Optional. The lead's lookup token — a random string Marketo assigns, often seen in landing page URLs.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Pick which fields to include. If you pick none, Marketo returns only the basics: id, email, first name, last name, and created/updated dates.

response.description: One lead object, keyed by field name, e.g. {"id": 123456, "email": "…", "firstName": "…"}.

notes: Returns 404 if no lead matches the ID or token.
With no fields selected, only id, email, firstName, lastName, createdAt, updatedAt come back — pick fields for a fuller record.
Lead IDs are per-instance — a lead's ID in one Marketo instance is meaningless in another.
